title: Positive part of a zero-sum family equals half its total variation
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite type and let $a : \alpha \to \bbr$ be a family of real numbers whose total sum vanishes, $\sum_{x} a(x) = 0$. Then
\[
\Bigl|\sum_{x} \max(a(x), 0)\Bigr| = \tfrac{1}{2} \sum_{x} \abs{a(x)}.
\]
